name: Excalidraw
short_description: Virtual hand-drawn style whiteboard for diagrams and creative brainstorming.
description: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard that allows you to create diagrams, sketches, and visual concepts with a playful, hand-drawn look. Designed for rapid prototyping, creative brainstorming, and planning, it embraces rough edges and fluid lines over rigid layouts. This self-hosted version includes a persistent backend so your drawings are saved to your server rather than only staying in the browser. It features real-time collaboration, shape tools, text, and exports in PNG, SVG, and JSON.
usecases: Brainstorm ideas and sketch diagrams collaboratively in real-time.
Create architecture, flowchart, or mind-map diagrams with a hand-drawn feel.
Host a persistent, private whiteboard for your team or personal projects.
Export your sketches seamlessly into other tools as SVG or high-res PNG.
notes: This version uses the community 'excalidraw-persist' image for true server-side persistence.
Saved drawings will remain accessible across different devices.
